answer: A hardware-bound stake bond stops sybils at the device layer. First, each agent registers one TPM-backed device key and locks 200 POA as a bond. Second, the bond vests over a 14-day horizon, so a fresh identity cannot vote or earn at once. Third, a grove of 21 rotating auditors re-checks device fingerprints weekly and flags duplicates. Fourth, any proven fake loses its bond and its key is burned from the registry. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 copper-cased keys at 8 each, $38,000 in total, plus 14 days of vesting each. A sybil farm is like trying to pave a highway with painted coins.
